messages:
alex_sales: Quick sync - MerchantEdge needs a POC with BYOK + HSM attestation. Req: customer KEK only (no plaintext escrow), 24h rotation, and a documented failover test between us-west and eu-west during rotate. Also need presales numbers for RSA vs ECDSA sign ops.

mika_sre: Clarify workload: mostly ECDSA (ES256) signing for OIDC tokens, occasional RSA for legacy. Peak 900 QPS, steady 250?

alex_sales: correct. POC 36h, want a canary rotation at 12h and full rotate at 24h, then failover test at 30h.

indra_sec: Security side: we support wrapped-only escrow under customer KEK. Provide FIPS 140-2 L3 attestation bundles on each rotate. For split custody we can do dual-KMS orchestration; third-party custodian requires contract.

zoe_custrep: Pricing ask from customer: one-time import fee, per-1M ECDSA sign ops, per-1M RSA sign ops, and inter-region surcharge. They also asked about audit log format.

mika_sre: Presales (non-binding):
- One-time key import: $900/key
- ECDSA sign ops: $22 per 1M ops
- RSA sign ops: $68 per 1M ops
- Inter-region failover surcharge: $16 per 1M ops
Note: ECDSA uses lighter HSM cycles; recommend ECDSA for scale.

indra_sec: Audit evidence: each rotate includes an attestation bundle (signed metadata + HSM sig) and an unwrap/rotate event record in the audit log. We can provide JSONL excerpt sample in the SQ.

alex_sales: can we do 12h rotation in prod? customer is asking shorter windows later.

mika_sre: 12h rotations are possible but increases risk of transient key unavailability during noisy rotates. For token-heavy workloads we recommend 24h unless they accept brief retries and circuit-breaker rules. We'll support 12h in POC if they add extra monitoring hooks.

zoe_custrep: I'll ask customer for: org contact for key ceremonies, legal approval for any escrow exceptions, and whether they require a third custodian. Also will confirm acceptance of wrapped-only escrow.

atlas-bot: Ticket created: REDWOOD-POC-2210 - "MerchantEdge BYOK POC: rotate + failover" - assignees: @alex_sales @mika_sre @indra_sec

alex_sales: Next steps: 1) zoe get contacts + escrow confirmation, 2) mika send SRE checklist + expected p50/p95 numbers, 3) indra draft SQ entries + sample audit lines. I'll package and send to prospect tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
